name: eye-comfort-profiles
description: Local, repeatable per-website reading settings for Chromium browsers.

scripts.build:site: vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && npm run package:extension
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:site
scripts.test: vitest run tests/model.test.ts tests/license.test.ts tests/release-config.test.ts tests/claims.test.ts
scripts.test:release: npm run clean && npm run build:site && vitest run tests/release-artifact.test.ts
